subtopics.name: Bethe-ansatz solvable quantum many-body models
subtopics.scope: Exact spectra, thermodynamics, finite-size effects and correlation functions of quantum integrable models such as XXZ, Hubbard, Lieb-Liniger and Gaudin, solved by coordinate, algebraic or nested Bethe ansatz.

subtopics.name: Solitons and the inverse scattering transform
subtopics.scope: Soliton, breather and rogue-wave solutions, conservation laws and long-time asymptotics of integrable nonlinear PDEs (KdV, NLS, sine-Gordon, KP) using Lax pairs and inverse scattering.

subtopics.name: Discrete integrable systems and lattice equations
subtopics.scope: Integrable difference and differential-difference equations, birational maps and ultradiscrete systems, characterised by multidimensional consistency, singularity confinement and low algebraic entropy.

subtopics.name: Painlevé equations and isomonodromic deformations
subtopics.scope: Painlevé transcendents and their discrete and higher-order analogues: special solutions, connection formulae, asymptotics, tau functions and isomonodromic Hamiltonian structure.

subtopics.name: Superintegrable and separable Hamiltonian systems
subtopics.scope: Classical and quantum Hamiltonian systems with extra integrals of motion or separable coordinates (Calogero-Moser, Kepler-type, Stäckel systems), their polynomial symmetry algebras and exact spectra.

subtopics.name: Lie symmetry analysis of differential equations
subtopics.scope: Point, contact, nonlocal and Noether symmetries of ordinary and partial differential equations, used to classify equations, build conservation laws and find invariant solutions.

subtopics.name: Random matrix ensembles and eigenvalue statistics
subtopics.scope: Eigenvalue densities, correlation kernels, gap probabilities, extreme eigenvalues and moments of Gaussian, Wishart, circular and β-ensembles, including Coulomb-gas and matrix-integral formulations.

subtopics.name: Exactly solved lattice models in statistical mechanics
subtopics.scope: Two-dimensional lattice models (Ising, Potts, six- and eight-vertex, dimers, hard hexagons) solved with transfer matrices, the Yang-Baxter equation, Pfaffians or corner transfer matrices.

subtopics.name: Interacting particle systems and KPZ universality
subtopics.scope: Exactly solvable stochastic particle systems and growth models (ASEP, TASEP, zero-range processes, directed polymers) analysed with integrable-probability tools.

subtopics.name: Mean-field spin glasses and disordered models
subtopics.scope: Free energies, phase transitions and ground-state properties of disordered mean-field models (Sherrington-Kirkpatrick, p-spin, random energy model, perceptron) and related random optimisation problems.

subtopics.name: Random Schrödinger operators and localization
subtopics.scope: Spectral and transport properties of Schrödinger and Jacobi operators with random or quasi-periodic potentials, including Anderson localization, Lyapunov exponents and the integrated density of states.

subtopics.name: Schrödinger operator spectra and eigenvalue bounds
subtopics.scope: Bound states, eigenvalue counting, resonances and sharp spectral inequalities (Lieb-Thirring, Hardy, CLR) for Schrödinger, Dirac and magnetic operators.

subtopics.name: Spectral geometry and quantum graphs
subtopics.scope: Eigenvalues of Laplace-type operators on domains, manifolds and metric graphs: Weyl asymptotics, isospectrality, nodal counts, eigenvalue optimisation and the effect of boundary or vertex conditions.

subtopics.name: Heat kernels, zeta functions and Casimir energies
subtopics.scope: Spectral functions of Laplace-type operators (heat-kernel coefficients, zeta-regularised determinants) and the vacuum (Casimir) energies of fields in bounded or topologically nontrivial geometries.

subtopics.name: Quantum fields in curved spacetime
subtopics.scope: Particle creation, vacuum polarisation, Hawking and Unruh effects, and renormalised stress tensors of quantum fields on black-hole, de Sitter and cosmological backgrounds.
keywords: quantum field theory in curved spacetime

subtopics.name: Exact solutions and perturbations in gravity
subtopics.scope: Exact solutions of Einstein and modified-gravity field equations and their linear perturbations: black holes, horizons, geodesic motion, quasinormal modes and stability.

subtopics.name: Two-dimensional conformal field theory and VOAs
subtopics.scope: Minimal models, Liouville and WZW theories, W-algebras and vertex operator algebras: characters, fusion rules, modular invariants, conformal blocks and boundary states.

subtopics.name: Exact results in supersymmetric gauge theories
subtopics.scope: Exact partition functions, indices, BPS spectra and prepotentials of supersymmetric gauge theories obtained from localization, Seiberg-Witten geometry and dualities.

subtopics.name: Scattering amplitudes and Feynman integrals
subtopics.scope: Analytic evaluation and structure of perturbative scattering amplitudes and multiloop Feynman integrals: polylogarithms, elliptic integrals, symbols, recursion relations and differential equations.

subtopics.name: Topological field theories and knot invariants
subtopics.scope: Chern-Simons and other topological quantum field theories, their partition functions, link and three-manifold invariants, and the associated quantum-group and modular-category structures.

subtopics.name: Topological solitons in classical field theory
subtopics.scope: Kinks, vortices, monopoles, instantons and skyrmions in classical field theories: BPS bounds, moduli spaces, energies, interactions and topological charges.

subtopics.name: Exactly solvable and non-Hermitian quantum mechanics
subtopics.scope: Exactly and quasi-exactly solvable potentials, supersymmetric quantum mechanics, shape invariance, exceptional orthogonal polynomials, and PT-symmetric or pseudo-Hermitian Hamiltonians.

subtopics.name: Semiclassical asymptotics, WKB and resurgence
subtopics.scope: Semiclassical and large-order behaviour in quantum mechanics and field theory: WKB and exact WKB, instantons, Borel summability, trans-series and resurgent structure.

subtopics.name: Open quantum systems and Lindblad dynamics
subtopics.scope: Markovian and non-Markovian dynamics of quantum systems coupled to environments: GKLS generators, quantum channels, steady states, spectral gaps and exactly solvable dissipative models.

subtopics.name: Orthogonal polynomials and special functions
subtopics.scope: Classical, q- and multivariate orthogonal polynomials and hypergeometric-type special functions: recurrences, asymptotics, zeros, generating functions and their algebraic structures (Askey-Wilson, Racah).

subtopics.name: Mean-field and kinetic limits of many-body systems
subtopics.scope: Derivation and analysis of effective equations (Hartree, Gross-Pitaevskii, Vlasov, Boltzmann) and Bogoliubov corrections for large interacting quantum and classical particle systems, including stability of matter.

techniques.name: Coordinate and algebraic Bethe ansatz
techniques.scope: Diagonalise integrable Hamiltonians or transfer matrices through Bethe equations, then get ground-state energies, excitations and finite-size corrections in the thermodynamic limit from root densities or nonlinear integral equations.

techniques.name: Riemann-Hilbert analysis and nonlinear steepest descent
techniques.scope: Recast a problem as a matrix Riemann-Hilbert problem and deform its contours (Deift-Zhou method) to obtain explicit leading and subleading asymptotics.

techniques.name: Hirota bilinear and Darboux-Bäcklund constructions
techniques.scope: Build explicit multi-soliton, breather, rational and determinant solutions from bilinear forms, tau functions and Darboux, Bäcklund or dressing transformations.

techniques.name: Transfer-matrix and Lyapunov exponent methods
techniques.scope: Write partition functions or one-dimensional eigenproblems as products of transfer matrices, whose leading eigenvalues or growth rates give free energies, correlation lengths or localization lengths.

techniques.name: Saddle-point and large-N asymptotics
techniques.scope: Evaluate integrals by Laplace and steepest-descent methods, including equilibrium measures and Coulomb-gas variational problems, to obtain leading and subleading large-parameter behaviour.

techniques.name: WKB, matched asymptotics and Borel resummation
techniques.scope: Use singular-perturbation expansions with turning-point connection formulas, boundary-layer matching, and Borel or Padé analysis of divergent series.

techniques.name: Perturbation theory and renormalization-group flow
techniques.scope: Expand order by order (Feynman diagrams or Rayleigh-Schrödinger) with regularisation to get beta functions, anomalous dimensions, fixed points and critical exponents.

techniques.name: Integration-by-parts and differential equations for integrals
techniques.scope: Reduce families of parametric integrals to master integrals and solve the resulting Picard-Fuchs or canonical differential equations, supplemented by Mellin-Barnes representations.

techniques.name: Spectral zeta functions and heat-kernel expansions
techniques.scope: Compute regularised determinants, vacuum energies and anomalies from zeta functions, Mellin transforms and heat-kernel asymptotic coefficients.

techniques.name: Toeplitz and Fredholm determinant asymptotics
techniques.scope: Express gap probabilities, emptiness formation, entanglement and correlation functions as Toeplitz, Hankel or Fredholm determinants and evaluate them with Szegő and Fisher-Hartwig asymptotics.

techniques.name: Replica and cavity methods
techniques.scope: Average over disorder with replicated partition functions or message-passing self-consistency, using replica-symmetric or symmetry-broken ansätze to obtain free energies and thresholds.

techniques.name: Representation theory and character formulas
techniques.scope: Use the representation theory of Lie (super)algebras, quantum groups and the Virasoro algebra (Casimirs, branching rules, Weyl-Kac characters, fusion) to obtain spectra, degeneracies and multiplicities.

techniques.name: Separation of variables and special functions
techniques.scope: In adapted coordinates, reduce linear PDEs or eigenvalue problems to ODEs solved by hypergeometric, Heun, Bessel or Mathieu functions, with spectra fixed by quantisation or boundary conditions.

techniques.name: Variational principles and sharp inequalities
techniques.scope: Derive optimal constants and exact bounds from min-max characterisations, trial states, Euler-Lagrange equations, and rearrangement or Sobolev-type inequalities.

techniques.name: Linear stability and normal-mode analysis
techniques.scope: Linearise around exact solutions to get eigenvalue problems, and compute their spectra (quasinormal frequencies, instability thresholds, bifurcation points) analytically or with shooting or spectral numerics.

techniques.name: Generating functions and exact enumeration
techniques.scope: Encode counting problems, partition functions and moments in generating functions, Pfaffians or Kasteleyn matrices, then use kernel and transfer methods to extract closed forms and asymptotic growth constants.
